exposure: number of full-time equivalent persons (i.e., 35 working hours per week) per 100 deliveries
Staffing levels of obstetricians and midwives
cohort: Deliveries of 102,236 women in 11 French hospitals from 2008-2014
finding: Higher staffing levels for both obstetricians and midwives were independently associated with lower rates of intrapartum and elective cesarean deliveries, respectively.
mod_finding: High staffing levels for obstetricians were associated with lower rates of intrapartum cesarean delivery.
